text: What is the computational content (under Curry-Howard) of a proof of A ∨ B?
choices: A function from A to B
A pair of type A × B
A tagged union: either a proof of A or a proof of B
explanation: Disjunction corresponds to the sum type A + B. A proof of A ∨ B is either inl(a) (a proof of A) or inr(b) (a proof of B).
